title: Every algebraic group scheme over a field is quasi-projective

standard_prerequisites.name: Explicit prerequisite boundary
standard_prerequisites.reference: Stable Stacks tags retained in assembly.external_references
standard_prerequisites.use: Algebraic group schemes, connected components, Cartier smoothness in characteristic zero and smoothness of reduced groups over a perfect field, descent of ampleness, regular-local factoriality, etale charts, divisor norms and rational equivalence of Picard classes over an open affine-space base.

core_obligations: Reduce across field extension, connected components and nilpotent structure using the stated classical group-scheme foundations.
Construct a family of translated effective divisors from a finite-etale chart whose common line-bundle class has affine nonvanishing loci covering the group.

proof_roadmap.step: Reduce across field extension, connected components and nilpotent structure using the stated classical group-scheme foundations.
Construct a family of translated effective divisors from a finite-etale chart whose common line-bundle class has affine nonvanishing loci covering the group.

difficulty_reason: The main proof creates an ample line bundle by translating a divisor through a finite-etale chart and simultaneously arranging affine complements and nonvanishing at each point. This constructive geometric step remains H2 after the standard reductions.

compared.difference: This migrates the existing unpublished research record, not an additional count beside it.

dedup.scope: Compared fixed tag/file/claim against local manifest, same-chapter primary titles/locators, 400 retired claims, research main-overlap and preparation worklist. Related standard tools and included support are not separately counted. No remote freshness or historical novelty asserted.
